purpose: Freeze the minimum modern Linux descriptor/event behavior required before systemd/dbus integration.

reference_cases.operation: pipe/readiness source registered level-triggered; unread data remains visible across waits
edge-triggered readiness emits transition behavior required by reference Linux
EPOLLONESHOT disables after delivery and rearms only through ctl MOD
close watched fd, reuse scalar fd number, prove old registration cannot attach to replacement generation
write/read eventfd counter, nonblocking empty read and overflow boundary
arm monotonic timerfd, observe expiration count and epoll readiness
block selected signal, receive it through signalfd, verify canonical signal queue consumption
watch directory, create/rename/delete one file, capture exact event order/masks used by pinned target
create memfd and exercise only seals observed as required by pinned target
bind pidfd to exact process generation and verify post-exit/reuse behavior
reference_cases.classification: promote only if deeper pinned systemd corpus observes mandatory pidfd operations

reference_cases.operation: close_range subset already surfaced by dbus reference evidence

runtime_owner_rules: one pollable/readiness-source contract shared by FD-backed objects
epoll registrations bind generation-safe descriptor/object identities
timerfd composes canonical time/scheduler owners and creates no second timer wheel
signalfd consumes canonical signal state and creates no shadow signal queue
inotify consumes canonical VFS mutation events and creates no shadow filesystem
pidfd never treats scalar PID as authority
